report.explanation: Current telemetry shows only healthy order-service behavior: all sampled logs are INFO with 200 responses, /v1/orders returns 200 with no 502s, and only baseline deployment v1.0.0 exists. No evidence substantiates a faulty deployment or any checkout error, so no candidate can be bounded; more evidence is required.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or traces showing the actual checkout failure (status, error message, failing dependency)
Metrics for checkout route error rate/5xx over the incident window, not just /v1/orders 200s
Deployment history showing any version change near incident onset (only baseline v1 present)
Downstream service (inventory/payment) latency and error telemetry during incident
